"Continue expanding my existing STILLWATER Xianxia Cultivation RPG.

I want to preserve the current game and its original gameplay, but introduce NEW features, deeper mechanics, more content and additional progression systems.

Do not convert it into another genre or redesign the entire game.

PART 1: Improve existing systems

1. Add more cultivation realms and sub-realms.
2. Expand Qi, Body and Spiritual cultivation.
3. Add Heavenly Tribulations and challenging breakthroughs.
4. Add more cultivation techniques and martial arts.
5. Add more enemies, spirit beasts and powerful bosses.
6. Expand sect missions, rankings, rewards and buildings.
7. Add more expeditions, rare resources and exploration locations.
8. Expand Alchemy with advanced pills and rare recipes.
9. Add more weapons, armour, artifacts and equipment rarities.
10. Add more achievements, quests and daily challenges.

PART 2: Introduce completely NEW features

1. Dao Comprehension

- Sword Dao, Fire Dao, Water Dao, Lightning Dao, Space Dao and Life Dao.
- Unlock permanent bonuses through Dao insights.
- Add Dao levels and mastery.

2. Spirit Beast Taming

- Discover and tame wild beasts.
- Collect beast eggs.
- Hatch, train and evolve companions.
- Add rare mythical beasts.

3. Ancient Inheritance

- Discover ancient cultivation legacies.
- Complete inheritance trials.
- Unlock forgotten techniques and legendary artifacts.

4. Secret Realms

- Add hidden dimensions and dangerous treasure locations.
- Introduce rare bosses and exclusive materials.
- Add exploration requirements and special rewards.

5. Spiritual Roots

- Add different elemental spiritual roots.
- Allow players to discover and upgrade their spiritual roots.
- Each root should provide different cultivation bonuses and abilities.
- Add rare Heavenly and Divine spiritual roots.

6. Meridians System

- Add a network of meridians that players can gradually unlock.
- Each unlocked meridian provides different stat bonuses.
- Add special meridian breakthrough requirements.

7. Weapon Refinement

- Allow players to upgrade, refine and awaken weapons.
- Add weapon-specific abilities.
- Add legendary and ancient weapons.

8. Fate and Fortune System

- Add a Luck attribute.
- Introduce random encounters, rare discoveries and fortune events.
- Add mysterious merchants and hidden treasures.

9. World Bosses

- Add powerful ancient beasts and demon kings.
- Give each boss unique abilities and rewards.
- Add progressively stronger boss challenges.

10. Reincarnation and Ascension

- Introduce a late-game reincarnation system.
- Allow players to gain permanent bonuses after reaching certain milestones.
- Add higher cultivation worlds after ascension.

PART 3: More engaging gameplay

- Add random cultivation events.
- Add wandering cultivators and mysterious merchants.
- Add treasure maps.
- Add rare resource gathering locations.
- Add NPC encounters and short story quests.
- Add hidden achievements.
- Add special breakthrough animations.
- Add rare equipment drops.
- Add limited-time cultivation events.

PART 4: Improve game depth

Make all these features interconnected with the existing cultivation, combat, sect, equipment, alchemy and expedition systems.

Every new feature must have:

- Actual gameplay mechanics.
- Unlock requirements.
- Progression and upgrade levels.
- Rewards.
- Proper UI.
- Persistent player data.

Maintain the current STILLWATER visual identity, existing navigation and mobile-friendly interface.

Do not delete or replace existing features. Implement new content directly into the existing game, test it and ensure everything works correctly.

Prioritise Spiritual Roots, Meridians, Dao Comprehension, Ancient Inheritance and Secret Realms as the first new features.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

Expand enemyKinds with realm tiers and rare drops. Add spirit beast taming: wild beasts appear; can "Tame" with chance based on luck/beast dao/companion. World bosses: level-gated bosses with unique abilities, HP huge, timed challenge. Use a boss battle UI with attack/arts. Rewards exclusive materials. Progressive tiers.

Missions expanded list (more targets, ranked missions with requirements, repeatable dailies). Rankings: leaderboard simulated with named NPCs and player position based on merit/power. Rewards at rank milestones. Buildings: Sect buildings upgradeable with stones/tokens: Meditation Hall (+qi), Herb Garden (+herb yield), Beast Pen (+tame), Formation Hall (+breakthrough), Armory (+gear). Each level bonus. Expand list with requirements/durations/rare resources/locations, exploration level. Add locations: Mistwood, Moonlit Ruins, Emberfall Ridge, Frozen Mirror Lake, Void Rift, etc. Each yields resources incl. new: ore, essence, crystal, relic, egg. Add travel party companion effects. Secret Realms as separate tab with requirements (stage, keys), bosses and exclusive materials.

Add ingredients (herb, root, flower, ore, essence, crystal, beastCore, voidDust...). Add recipes advanced tiers: Qi pills, breakthrough pills (increase chance), tribulation pills, luck elixir, companion feed, meridian elixir, dao incense, ascension pill. Unlock requirements (alchemy level from brews/stage). Alchemy level increases yield. UI show locked recipes.

Add rarities, weapons with names and abilities, armor slots. Existing gearCatalog has 6 pieces. Expand: weapon types (sword, saber, spear, fan), armor, artifacts (2 slots). - Add `weapons` catalog: Ironwood Sword, Mistfang Blade, Emberfang Saber, Frost Mirror Sword, Void Piercer, Heaven's Edge. Each with rarity, attack, ability, cost (stones + ore + boss mats), unlock stage. Equip one weapon. Weapon has refine level (0-10) and awakened flag (ability unlocked).

Persistent.

- tick chooses event when none and time reached; `worldEvent.next` in seconds. currentEvent uses ends timestamp. On tick, if none and totalSeconds >= next -> pick event, set ends = Date.now()+duration*1000, next = totalSeconds+300 etc. Render banners.
- Could also event effects for attack. Already currentEvent buffs. Add login.

#### Achievements:
- called in save; but need check after actions. Save does. Good. However checkAchievements -> applyReward -> may modify state but no save until later. Fine.

#### Fate details:
Need design rewards; use existing applyReward. We'll implement resolution outcomes with randomness and luck. Show toast, append log.

Merchant: build offers each new day. `state.fate.merchantDate`. On render or ensureFate, if merchantDate != dayIndex, generate deterministic subset from merchantPool with ids, bought false. Use dayHash.
- Buy merchant: cost, grant object; applyReward mostly supports keys, egg, food, rootEssence, map, coins; but merchant grants `grant` includes herb/ore/crystal direct, luck, breakBuff, egg, keys, map, rootEssence. Implement custom applyMerchantGrant.

Use map: spend 1 map, random reward: stones, keys, relic, fragment; questStep('map'); daily? stats.chests++ for hidden achievement. state.fate.fragments maybe count. Treasure maps maybe map fragments; state.fate.fragments can track.

Fate pending generation: tick every ~90s if none and random chance; or player "Walk the road" action generates one immediately with cooldown? State.fate.clock used. We'll implement `seek-fate` button: cost 20 qi? and generates pending. Also every 180s tick auto maybe.

#### World boss damage:
Implement helper `dealBossDamage(rawDamage, source, options)`.
- Compute crit chance; sword heart ability: crit +25%; heaven's edge weapon +35%; lightning lv3 restore 4 qi; fire dao lv3 20% burn extra.
- enemy damage retaliation after player's attack (unless evade from space lv3 or mistfang 10%), reduced by guard, trait.
- regen each turn, drain qi, pierce guard, storm every third turn extra.
- On victory: rewards, drops, artifact, state.world.defeated[id]++, tier=max(tier, def.tier+1), stats.bosses++, daily/mission/quest, achievements, save/render.
- log last 4.

Secret realm battle similar but with `state.realms.boss`. Could reuse helpers but separate state. Implement generic `realmAttack(kind, id)`.

#### Ascension math:
Rebirth points formula: `Math.max(1, Math.floor(state.stage * 0.75 + totalMastery() * 0.5 + (state.stats.bosses||0)*2))`. Need require stage >= 20, count. On reincarnate:
- Keep permanent: root, meridians, dao xp, taming beasts, inheritance, forge weapons/artifacts, achievements, stats, rebirth, world defeated? Maybe keep world progress? Reset stage to 0, qi 0, stones maybe 100 + points*20, upgrades reset, pathLevels reset, boosts 0, daily reset, enemy/boss null, trip null, quests maybe keep completed? Keep quests completed and inheritance, etc.
- Add rebirth.points += earned, rebirth.count++, world maybe unchanged.
- Show modal.
Ascend world: require stage >= 25 and world tier maybe; require all world bosses? Use stage >= 25 && state.world.tier >= 4; increments rebirth.world, resets stage and some progress, adds permanent world multiplier (already in derived stats), keeps things. Maybe also require `state.stage >= 25`. Show confirm modal.
- Rebirth upgrade spend: costs 1/2/3 points, apply.

#### Codex:
- Realms list using realmBands; show start/end requirements maybe.
- Achievements defs with unlocked states and hidden masks.
- Quests: available / active / completed; actions accept-quest, claim-quest. For gather quest, progress derives herb count, so check claim works. On claim, maybe consume herbs? Should consume target herbs for gather to avoid free repeat? Only once per quest, so okay but consuming makes sense. Deduct herbs on claim for gather.
- Records: stats grid.

#### HTML/CSS support:
We need ensure `.view` display none active. Existing CSS `.view{display:none}.view.active{display:block}` likely. Check. Also mobile nav 13 buttons could overflow; CSS maybe handles horizontal scroll. Check .mobile-nav.

## Objective
- Expand the existing STILLWATER Xianxia Cultivation RPG with playable cultivation, exploration, combat, and progression systems while preserving its original gameplay and visual identity.
- Finish integrating and validating the expansion, including mobile-friendly UI and persistent data.

## Requirements
- Keep the existing game and navigation; do not change genres or remove features.
- Add the requested cultivation, combat, sect, exploration, alchemy, equipment, achievement, and progression systems.
- Test the finished game; make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implement the expansion directly in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js`.
- Use browser-based Playwright checks to exercise navigation, tabs, and game actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded `index.html` navigation and views, appended expansion styles to `styles.css`, and added the expanded engine and systems to `game.js`.
- Fixed Fate and Ascension views to render into their view containers with headings.
- `node --check game.js` passed during testing.
- Playwright navigation checks identified and resolved the Fate and Ascension rendering issue.

### Active
- Finish browser testing of tabs and gameplay actions; test output showed test harness selector/seed issues, and action testing remains incomplete.
- Inspect responsive layout and screenshot; verify the current game visually.
- Check integration, persistent state, and regressions against the original game.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run syntax checks and repair any issues found during gameplay tests.
2. Complete browser tests for all navigation views, tabs, and representative game actions using a valid save seed.
3. Check desktop and mobile layouts, capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot, and fix any issues.
4. Summarize the implemented features and test results; note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Expanded application markup and navigation.
- `styles.css`: Original styles plus expansion styles.
- `game.js`: Expansion engine, rendering, actions, and persistence.

## Important Context
- Changes were made directly in the repository; no commit was reported.
- Test scripts were created under `/tmp/opencode/`, including `test-game.cjs`, `test-tabs.cjs`, `test-actions.cjs`, and `debug-actions.cjs`; action-test results are not yet established.

## Objective
- Expand STILLWATER into a playable cultivation RPG while preserving its original gameplay and visual identity.
- Complete and validate the expansion, including mobile UI and persistent saves.

## Requirements
- Keep the existing game and navigation; do not change genres or remove features.
- Add cultivation, combat, sect, exploration, alchemy, equipment, achievement, and progression systems.
- Test the finished game and make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented the expansion in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js`.
- Used browser-based Playwright checks for navigation, tabs, gameplay actions, persistence, and responsive layouts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added cultivation, combat, roots and Dao, sects, expeditions, crafting, inheritance, Fate, reincarnation, ascension, achievements, and related progression systems.
- Fixed Fate and Ascension rendering and adjusted mobile navigation scrolling and toast placement.
- Validated navigation, tabs, representative gameplay actions, save migration and persistence, and desktop/mobile layouts.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed; reported no browser or console errors.

- (none)

- (none)

## Next Move
1. (none)

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/test-extra.cjs`: Playwright gameplay and persistence checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-edge.cjs`: Playwright edge-case and progression checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-mobile.cjs`: Mobile navigation and layout checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-migrate.cjs`: Legacy-save migration check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js`.
- Progress uses the existing `stillwater-cultivator-v1` localStorage key; legacy saves migrate automatically.
- Mobile users access later navigation items by horizontally swiping the bottom navigation.

## Objective
- Expand STILLWATER into a playable cultivation RPG while preserving its gameplay and visual identity.
- Improve existing progression systems, make unlock requirements explicit, and increase base qi growth.

## Requirements
- Preserve existing gameplay and navigation; do not remove features or change genres.
- Add cultivation, combat, sect, exploration, alchemy, equipment, achievement, and progression systems.
- Test the finished game, including mobile UI and persistent saves, and make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented the expansion and progression tuning in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js`.
- Increased base qi growth to 2.5 qi/sec, added stage/path/technique scaling, and raised idle/offline gain to 50% of active rate.
- Added and enforced stage requirements for techniques, sect-rank requirements for gear and buildings, and a stage 4 requirement for switching sects.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added cultivation, combat, roots and Dao, sects, expeditions, crafting, inheritance, Fate, reincarnation, ascension, achievements, and related progression systems.
- Tuned qi growth and added visible, enforced unlock requirements across progression systems.
- Fixed Fate and Ascension rendering and adjusted mobile navigation scrolling and toast placement.
- Validated navigation, gameplay actions, persistence and save migration, requirements, and desktop/mobile layouts.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` pass; gameplay, edge-case, mobile, and migration Playwright tests report no page or console errors.

- `/tmp/opencode/test-extra.cjs`: Playwright gameplay and persistence checks.

- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js`.
- Progress uses the existing `stillwater-cultivator-v1` localStorage key; legacy saves migrate automatically.
- Mobile users access later navigation items by horizontally swiping the bottom navigation.

## Objective
- Improve STILLWATER’s existing sidebar and Sanctuary dashboard while keeping its visual identity, gameplay, and shared player progression.
- Make the requested interface and gameplay improvements functional and connected to existing systems.

## Requirements
- Keep the sidebar navigation, Sanctuary design, existing features, and jade-green, cream, and gold Xianxia aesthetic.
- Make every sidebar section functional; improve character stats, cultivation progress, activities, notifications, progression trees, collections, exploration, sect/inheritance/forge/fate interactions, animations, tooltips, and mobile layouts.
- Avoid duplicate systems and placeholder screens; use the existing player data and progression.

## Decisions
- Extend the existing shared save state in `game.js`; add defaults and migration handling for notifications, discoveries, and sect perks.
- Add Body, Soul, and Qi milestone trees and connect their bonuses to existing calculations; add aggregate Inner Dao harmony bonuses.
- Add collections to the existing Codex, with entries derived from current save data.
- Preserve the existing sidebar and Sanctuary navigation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added Sanctuary character-sheet and notification render calls, plus render functions for stats, loadout, and recent notifications.
- Added Body, Soul, and Qi milestone-tree rendering and wired several tree bonuses into qi, attack, health, guard, Dao insight, breakthrough, and luck calculations.
- Added a Collections Codex tab and began rendering bestiary, equipment, technique, and root collections from existing data.
- Added tooltip definitions/helpers and visual-effect helper functions; these are not yet comprehensively wired to gameplay events.
- Added defaults and migration checks for newly introduced state fields.

### Active
- Finish and validate the ongoing Codex collections edit and inspect the resulting `game.js` for syntax/runtime issues.
- Implement remaining requested functional improvements, including exploration region maps/discoveries, meaningful Sect Hall/Inheritance/Forge/Fate interactions, activity/notification integration, animations, tooltips, and mobile navigation/layout improvements.
- Run gameplay, persistence, responsive, and regression tests after completing the changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `game.js` around `renderCodex()` and run `node --check game.js`; fix any incomplete or inconsistent edits.
2. Complete the remaining requested features using existing systems and shared save data.
3. Validate desktop/mobile UI, gameplay actions, save migration/persistence, and check `git diff`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Sanctuary additions and tooltip/effect containers.
- `styles.css`: Existing application styles; responsive and new UI styling still needs review.
- `game.js`: Shared state, calculations, rendering, actions, and the in-progress feature work.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-extra.cjs`: Prior Playwright gameplay and persistence checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-edge.cjs`: Prior progression and edge-case checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-mobile.cjs`: Prior mobile navigation/layout checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-migrate.cjs`: Prior legacy-save migration check.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-req2.cjs`: Prior progression requirement checks.

## Important Context
- Changes to `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js` are uncommitted.
- The latest `renderCodex()` collections insertion was applied, but no validation or tests were run afterward; the previous validation results predate these latest edits.
- The save uses `stillwater-cultivator-v1`; existing progress should continue using the same key.
